title: The Ass and the Lapdog

full_text:
An ass noticed how tenderly his master pampered a tiny lapdog: the little dog was fed choice meat from the table, carried in the master's arms, and kissed affectionately whenever it leaped onto his lap and wagged its tail.

The ass thought: "If I act playful and affectionate like that little creature, the master will love me too and feed me sweets instead of dry straw!"

Breaking from his halter, the clumsy ass galloped into the dining parlor, kicked over the tea table, brayed loudly, and leaped with his heavy hooves straight onto the master's chest, licking his face with a rough, slobbery tongue!

Terrified by the assault, the master shouted for help. The servants rushed in with heavy staves and gave the clumsy ass such a merciless thrashing that he barely crawled back to his stable, realizing that an ass can never play the part of a lapdog.
moral: Do not attempt to ape manners that nature never intended for you.
